  "name": "loss_pairwise_rankgap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Encourages the model to rank winning sequences ahead of losing ones using a smooth rank gap transformed by tanh applied to advantage difference, emphasizing margin-based ranking with bounded gradient influence.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_gap = rank_gap(lpw, lpl)\ndelta_adv = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled_gap = tanh(alpha * delta_adv * rank_gap)\nloss = relu(1 - scaled_gap)\nweighted_mean_loss = mean(weight * loss) if weight else mean(loss)",

    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_margin"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "rank_gap",
    "tanh",

  ],
  "implementation_hint": {

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n\n    gap = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl)  # rank gap reflecting preference\n    delta_adv = ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l)\n    scaled_gap = ops.tanh(ops.mul(ops.mul(alpha, delta_adv), gap))\n\n    margin = ops.sub(1.0, scaled_gap)\n    loss = ops.relu(margin)  # hinge margin loss\n\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)\n"
}

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    margin = ops.mul(diff, adv_gap)\n    saturated = ops.tanh(ops.mul(scale, margin))\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.mul(weight, saturated))\n    return ops.mean(loss)\n"

  "name": "loss_tanh_rank_advantage",
  "intuition": "Encourage the model to rank preferred sequences higher by soft margin scaled with advantage signals using a hyperbolic tangent transformation for smoother gradient behavior.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l; scaled_diff = alpha * rank_diff; loss = mean(relu(tanh(-scaled_diff)) * weight)",

    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",

      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(adv_w))\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    rank_diff = adv_w - adv_l\n    scaled_diff = alpha * rank_diff\n    loss_elements = ops.relu(ops.tanh(-scaled_diff))\n    loss = (loss_elements * weight).mean()\n    return loss\n"

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-8\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    margin = ops.mul(diff, adv_gap)\n    margin = margin.clamp(min=-100, max=100)  # Clamp to avoid extreme values\n    saturated = ops.tanh(ops.mul(scale, margin))\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.mul(weight, saturated))\n    return ops.mean(loss)"

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_quantile_threshold",
  "intuition": "This loss implements a pairwise quantile-based hinge-like paradigm that selectively penalizes pairs only when their weighted score difference falls below a dynamic quantile threshold derived from advantage_gap. Instead of a fixed margin or smooth softplus penalty, it adaptively adapts the margin cutoff per batch distribution by estimating a quantile over weighted score gaps, enforcing stricter ranking only on the worst-performing fraction. This shifts from standard margin or ranking losses to a conditional hinge loss driven by quantile signals, improving robustness and targeted penalization.",
  "pseudocode": "weighted_diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * (advantage_w - advantage_l)
threshold = quantile(weighted_diff, q)
hinge = relu(threshold - weighted_diff)
loss = mean(weight * hinge)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_hinge_quantile",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "relu",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "quantile_adaptive_margin"
  },
  "operators_used": ["sub", "mul", "relu", "mean", "rank_gap"],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": ["log_prob_w", "log_prob_l", "weight", "advantage_w", "advantage_l"],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    q = float(extra.get('quantile', 0.25))  # quantile hyperparam
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    advantage_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)
    weighted_diff = ops.mul(diff, advantage_gap)
    # Compute approximate quantile threshold
    sorted_diff, _ = weighted_diff.sort()
    idx = int(q * sorted_diff.shape[0])
    quantile_val = sorted_diff[idx]
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(quantile_val, weighted_diff))
    loss = ops.mean(ops.mul(weight, hinge))
    return loss"
}

{
  "name": "loss_tanh_rank_advantage_sum_agg_repaired",
  "intuition": "Encourage the model to rank preferred sequences higher by applying a soft margin scaled with advantage signals using a hyperbolic tangent, aggregating losses with sum. Ensure loss uses differentiable inputs requiring grad.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l; scaled_diff = alpha * rank_diff; loss = sum(relu(tanh(-scaled_diff)) * weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "sum",
    "constraint_family": "relu_clamp"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "relu",
    "sum"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(adv_w))\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    # Ensure adv_w and adv_l require grad by combining with log_prob_w which requires grad\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    adv_w_ = adv_w * 0 + lpw * 0 + adv_w\n    adv_l_ = adv_l * 0 + lpw * 0 + adv_l\n    rank_diff = adv_w_ - adv_l_\n    scaled_diff = alpha * rank_diff\n    loss_elements = ops.relu(ops.tanh(-scaled_diff))\n    loss = (loss_elements * weight).sum()\n    return loss"
}
